expenditures.detail: exact (14031.87 = 14031.87). The 8 rows sum to 14031.87 = the attachment's handwritten 'TOTAL: $14,031.87' = Summary Page line 2 Column A.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The printed Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p4) carry NO rows and NO subtotal or total figures - 'SEE ATTACHMENTS' is written below each grid - so no page-subtotal gate exists on the forms. The gates that DO exist are the handwritten TOTAL lines on the attachments themselves, and both fired and passed to the cent (contributions 7998.55 across p5+p6; expenditures 14031.87 on p7). FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: p5 has 13 names against 13 amounts, p6 has 10 against 10, p7 has 8 against 8.
itemized.escalation_note: pages 3-8 were first classified from a 110 dpi contact pass and then re-rendered at 220 dpi, which is the transcription source; nothing needed a cell crop (the attachments are typed and crisp)
itemized.notes: FAXED FILING, PAGES OUT OF ORDER. The fax cover sheet is PDF page 8 even though its own fax header reads 'PAGE 01' (fax banner '10/31/2006 08:26  8017470480  MATHESON&PESHELL', 8 pages including cover, addressed to Jessica Keers, S.L. County Elections Clerk). The printed Schedule A (PDF p3, form 'Page 3 of 7') and Schedule B (PDF p4, form 'Page 4 of 7') are entirely EMPTY with 'SEE ATTACHMENTS' hand-written below each grid; the itemization is on three typed campaign letterhead pages, hand-numbered 'PAGE 5 of 7', '6 of 7' and '7 of 7' and initialled 'WILDE, 10-31-06'. Each attachment covers the stated period 9/15/06 - 10/31/06 and carries its own handwritten TOTAL. The ADDRESS column exists on all three attachments but is blank; on the expenditure sheet a few stray digit fragments survive at the column's left edge, which reads as a county redaction - either way no city or state is recoverable, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. IN-KIND items appear on BOTH sides and match each other: Gastronomy $500 in-kind contribution against a $500 in-kind 'Fundraiser Lunch', S.L. Co. Rep. Pty. $2,750 in-kind against the $2,750 'Election Guide Ad' marked '(In kind-party)' and paid to NAC, and Mark Crockett $500 in-kind against $500 of 'Campaign Aides'. Several contributions come from sitting county councilmen (Marv Hendrickson, Mark Crockett).
